newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro starts.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities analyst Martin Lara said he had started coverage of Mexico's Grupo Radio Centro with a rating of buy.
-- In a Jan 17 report, Lara said the company "is expected to see strong growth as the broadcast advertising market improves," with "impressive cash flow in 1997 and beyond."

-- "Our 12-month price target is $10 (per American Depositary Receipt), representing a nominal peso return of 45 percent and a U.S. dollar return of 26 percent, including a one percent dividend yield."
-- The company's shares were unchanged at 8-1/8 on Monday in New York.
